description: This source file implements functions related to managing and optimizing packfile geometries in a version control system (likely Git). It includes initializing, splitting, selecting preferred packs, and removing redundant packs, with detailed logic for geometric progression and pack management.

methods.description: Calculates the weight of a packfile, which is its number of objects.

methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry by collecting relevant packfiles based on criteria such as locality, keep flags, and cruft status.

methods.description: Determines where to split packfiles into groups based on size progression for efficient packing.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Calculates split points for packfile groups based on geometric progression criteria.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Selects the preferred packfile for further operations, based on size and locality considerations.

methods.name: void remove_redundant_packs(struct packed_git ** pack,uint32_t pack_nr,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packfiles that are not kept or already included in a string list.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the current geometry based on a list of names.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for packfile arrays in pack geometry.
